name: Civil unrest
summary: France's large strike day against austerity on 5 Nov; unions plan more action, no deaths reported
state: Hundreds of thousands joined strikes and marches across France on 5 Nov against austerity plans in the 2027 budget, among the largest protests in years (Sortiraparis; Strat News Global). Unions have called further action into December (Connexion). No deaths had been reported as of 7 Nov, so the Alert line of deadly nationwide unrest is not crossed.
for_you: Travellers to France can check FCDO advice and expect transport disruption on strike days.
rubric_hit: Significant protests in a major country = Watch; not deadly (Alert)

sources.title: Connexion — French unions call for new round of strike action in December
Strat News Global — Macron faces growing pressure as French unions strike

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
